premises: M and N are pure uint32_t scalar values, N>0, no side effects or repeated macro-argument evaluation effects. The bounded consumer observes the local ceiling-division value, not Vulkan or caller state.
normalization: Use m,n as unsigned 32-bit inputs. Expand comparison-to-integer conversion as an if with add-one versus no-add branches. A separate reference returns zero for m=0 and 1+(m-1)/n otherwise. Source-if trace is that of the explicit scalar normalization, not a native macro trace.
repair_region: m > UINT32_MAX - (n-1), where the mathematical numerator m+n-1 exceeds UINT32_MAX
